rootCause.rootCause: The `is_whitespace` attribute is set to `False` for all `RawSegment` instances by default in `BaseSegment.is_whitespace = False` (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/base.py#L55-L90). This is a machine-protected invariant because ordinary code segments must remain non-whitespace. The `WhitespaceSegment` and `newline` segments are defined in `src/sqlfluff/core/rules/base.py#L395-L425` with `is_whitespace=True` and `type='whitespace'`/`type='newline'`, but these are not inherited by the runtime-generated segment classes due to the default `is_whitespace=False` in `BaseSegment`. The `RawSegment.make` method (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/raw.py#L1-L145) does not override this default unless explicitly provided in `kwargs`, which is not done for whitespace tokens in the ANSI dialect (src/sqlfluff/core/dialects/dialect_ansi.py#L45-L95).
rootCause.risk: Changing `is_whitespace=False` to `True` for whitespace tokens would violate the machine-protected invariant that ordinary code segments must remain non-whitespace. This could lead to incorrect parsing and analysis of SQL code.
